entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi Isaac, I'd like to start a return for a helmet I bought recently.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, can you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault with the helmet or more of a personal preference?
It's a preference thing. The color on the website looked like a bright red, but in person, it's more of a muted burgundy. It's a nice helmet, just not what I was expecting.
I see. I can definitely appreciate wanting the color to be just right. Have you used the helmet at all?
Nope, the box is still unopened. I saw the shade through the plastic window and knew it wasn't for me.

Okay, thanks for clarifying. Let me just pull up our return policy. I see your order was delivered 27 days ago. Our policy allows for returns on standard items for up to 90 days, as long as they are in their original condition. Since you're well within that timeframe, I can approve this return for a full refund.

That's great news, I appreciate it. Now, since I'll be ordering the correct color from you and have to go through the hassle of shipping this one back, would it be possible to get a 15% discount code for my next purchase?

I understand the request, but I'm afraid I'm not authorized to provide discount codes for a preference-based return. I can, however, email you the pre-paid shipping label right now to make the process as easy as possible for you.

Okay, I get it. How about this then: instead of a refund to my credit card, could you issue a store credit for the full amount plus an extra $10 for the inconvenience? I'm going to be buying from you again anyway.

While I can process the return for a full refund or store credit, I can't add extra funds as this wasn't a VeloFit error. Getting you a full refund is the best I can do. We want to ensure you have a helmet you love, especially for safety on the road.
Alright, a full refund is acceptable. I had to try. Please go ahead and send me the return label.
Of course. I've just sent that to the email on file. You should see it within the next few minutes. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thanks for your help, Isaac.
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
